scope: 27 Luna book-body frames + 54 Erna standard/travel runtime frames; attachment-point candidates only
coordinateSystem: source image pixel coordinates, origin top-left; canvas is 256x256
authority: Derived from world R1 gear intent and visually checked source-grid contacts. Does not approve equipment appearance, art changes, or renderer integration.

measurement.method: Each source frame has an addressable marker contact showing the exact BODY01 point against that original 256x256 frame and a 16-source-pixel grid. Coordinates are approximate visual readings, not segmentation-derived truth; marker contacts allow per-image correspondence review.
measurement.body01: Small detail anchor follows the screen-right outer lower hem; intentionally avoids center-front white cloth and exposed skin/legs. Runtime fit, layer order, and exact clipping remain unverified.
measurement.body02: Marked unknown/occluded on every row because the baked source frames do not expose a separable inner lining surface with enough certainty. Do not render until Art supplies a validated surface/mask or separate layer.
